title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale pre-training has made robot policy fine-tuning increasingly data-efficient, but this progress has largely been driven by datasets and embodiments built around simple parallel-jaw grippers. Dexterous, multi-fingered hands remain comparatively data-starved because real teleoperation is costly to scale, while human hand video is off-embodiment and requires lossy pose estimation and retargeting. We introduce Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD), a pre-training framework for dexterous manipulation that uses data entirely collected in simulation. In SPD, humans manipulate virtual objects inside a VR headset, enabling on-embodiment trajectories and robot-free collection. With the help of five operators, we collect 75 hours of multi-task dexterous manipulation over one week, and use it to pre-train a causal transformer on a sequence modeling objective. translated_title: 在仿真中预训练灵巧操作技能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15917v1 公告类型：交叉 公告摘要：大规模预训练已使机器人策略微调越来越数据高效，但这一进展主要由围绕简单平行夹爪构建的数据集和本体所驱动。灵巧的多指手仍相对数据匮乏，因为真实遥操作成本高昂难以扩展，而人类手部视频脱离本体，需要有损姿态估计和重定向。我们引入了灵巧操作仿真预训练（SPD），一种完全使用仿真中收集数据的灵巧操作预训练框架。在SPD中，人类在VR头显内操作虚拟物体，实现了本体轨迹和无机器人收集。借助五名操作员，我们在一周内收集了75小时的多任务灵巧操作数据，并用其在一个序列建模目标上预训练了一个因果变换器。我们通过将预训练模型微调到现实世界任务来研究仿真预训练的好处。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SPD的仿真预训练框架，利用VR头显收集人类在虚拟环境中的灵巧操作数据，以预训练模型并提升现实世界灵巧操作的微调效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SPD, a simulation pre-training framework that collects human dexterous manipulation data via VR headsets to pre-train models, enhancing fine-tuning efficiency for real-world dexterous tasks.
